segments.an4.67:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.an4.67:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅkato hoti.
segments.an4.67:1.3: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.an4.67:1.4: “idha, bhante, sāvatthiyaṃ aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅkato”ti.
segments.an4.67:2.1: “Na hi nūna [na ha nūna (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari.
segments.an4.67:2.2: Sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅkareyya.
segments.an4.67:3.2: Virūpakkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.
segments.an4.67:3.3: Na hi nūna so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari.
segments.an4.67:3.4: Sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅkareyya.
segments.an4.67:4.1: “Anujānāmi, bhikkhave, imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena pharituṃ attaguttiyā attarakkhāya attaparittāyā”ti.
segments.an4.67:5.1: [cūḷava.251; jā.1.2.105 passitabbaṃ]“Virūpakkhehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ erāpathehi me;
segments.an4.67:5.3: Chabyāputtehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ kaṇhāgotamakehi ca.
segments.an4.67:6.1: “Apādakehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ dvipādakehi [dipādakehi (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] me;
segments.an4.67:6.3: Catuppadehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ bahuppadehi me.
segments.an4.67:7.1: “Mā maṃ apādako hiṃsi, mā maṃ hiṃsi dvipādako [dipādako (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)];
segments.an4.67:7.3: Mā maṃ catuppado hiṃsi, mā maṃ hiṃsi bahuppado.
segments.an4.67:8.1: “Sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā, sabbe bhūtā ca kevalā;
segments.an4.67:8.3: Sabbe bhadrāni passantu, mā kañci [kiñci (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] pāpamāgamā.
segments.an4.67:9.3: Appamāṇo saṅgho, pamāṇavantāni sarīsapāni [siriṃsapāni (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.an4.67:10.3: Katā me rakkhā katā me parittā [kataṃ me parittaṃ (?)], paṭikkamantu bhūtāni;
segments.an4.67:10.5: Sohaṃ namo bhagavato, namo sattannaṃ sammāsambuddhānan”ti.

lines: Sattame imāni cattāri ahirājakulānīti idaṃ daṭṭhavisāneva sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Ye hi keci daṭṭhavisā, sabbete imesaṃ catunnaṃ ahirājakulānaṃ abbhantaragatāva honti.

words: katā me rakkhā  katā me parittā
lines: Idāni yathā taṃ parittaṃ kātabbaṃ, taṃ dassento virūpakkhehi metiādimāha.
Sabbe sattāti ito pubbe ettakena ṭhānena odissakamettaṃ kathetvā idāni anodissakamettaṃ kathetuṃ idamāraddhaṃ.
Mā kañci pāpamāgamāti kañci sattaṃ pāpakaṃ lāmakaṃ mā āgacchatu.
Katā me rakkhā, katā me parittāti mayā ettakassa janassa rakkhā ca parittāṇañca kataṃ.
Paṭikkamantu bhūtānīti sabbepi me kataparittāṇā sattā apagacchantu, mā maṃ viheṭhayiṃsūti attho.
